insights.title: Lead efficiency to investigate: Remarketing - Opened Form no Submit
insights.observation: $153.49 generated 23 leads at $6.67 CPL. This is 38.3% of leads on 11.7% of spend; the account CPL is $21.90.
insights.action: Review this ad set’s audience, offer and relevant storage capacity before a small budget test. Check lead quality separately; past CPL does not establish how extra spend will perform.
insights.basis: Lowest CPL among ad sets with at least 10 reported leads; descriptive, not a controlled experiment.

insights.title: Review higher-cost enquiries: Chattanooga, TN
insights.observation: $512.30 generated 15 leads at $34.15 CPL, 55.9% above the account average.
insights.action: Inspect the audience, offer and individual ads. Use a controlled change and monitor the next comparable period rather than assuming the audience should be paused.
insights.basis: Comparison mixes different audiences and locations; it does not measure lead quality.

insights.title: Lead volume is concentrated in one ad
insights.observation: 01 (Remarketing - Opened Form no Submit) generated 23 leads at $6.67 CPL — 38.3% of account leads.
insights.action: Keep a tested alternative creative available and monitor this ad weekly. Unequal delivery means this is not proof that its creative is intrinsically better.
insights.basis: Lead-share calculation uses ad-level results reconciled to the account; no causal creative ranking.

insights.title: Creative fatigue is not established
insights.observation: 1 ad set(s) had enough activity for the seven-day fatigue check; none met all three warning conditions.
insights.action: Keep monitoring frequency, link CTR and CPL together. Review individual ads when all three deteriorate; low-volume groups remain inconclusive.
insights.basis: 2026-06-17–2026-06-23 vs 2026-06-24–2026-06-30. Screening rule requires frequency +20%, link CTR −15% and CPL +20%, with 5 leads, 30 link clicks and 1,000 impressions in each window. No flag does not prove the absence of fatigue.

insights.title: Cost per lead 23.8% higher than last month
insights.observation: July: $2,169.78, 80 leads and $27.12 CPL. Prior month: $1,314.17, 60 leads and $21.90 CPL. Largest lead gain: Chattanooga, TN (+16 leads, +382.25 USD spend change). Largest lead decline: Remarketing - Opened Form no Submit (-6 leads, +152.34 USD spend change).
insights.action: Review the largest declining ad set first and compare its offer, audience and ads with the prior month. Change one factor at a time.
insights.basis: Complete calendar months; Meta lead action only. Different month lengths and lead quality can affect interpretation.

insights.title: Lead efficiency to investigate: Remarketing - Opened Form no Submit
insights.observation: $305.83 generated 17 leads at $17.99 CPL. This is 21.2% of leads on 14.1% of spend; the account CPL is $27.12.
insights.action: Review this ad set’s audience, offer and relevant storage capacity before a small budget test. Check lead quality separately; past CPL does not establish how extra spend will perform.
insights.basis: Lowest CPL among ad sets with at least 10 reported leads; descriptive, not a controlled experiment.

insights.title: Review higher-cost enquiries: Bartow, Hawthorne, FL
insights.observation: $291.48 generated 5 leads at $58.30 CPL, 114.9% above the account average.
insights.action: Inspect the audience, offer and individual ads. Use a controlled change and monitor the next comparable period rather than assuming the audience should be paused.
insights.basis: Comparison mixes different audiences and locations; it does not measure lead quality.

insights.title: Lead volume is concentrated in one ad
insights.observation: 02 (Chattanooga, TN) generated 30 leads at $28.68 CPL — 37.5% of account leads.
insights.action: Keep a tested alternative creative available and monitor this ad weekly. Unequal delivery means this is not proof that its creative is intrinsically better.
insights.basis: Lead-share calculation uses ad-level results reconciled to the account; no causal creative ranking.

insights.title: Creative fatigue is not established
insights.observation: 1 ad set(s) had enough activity for the seven-day fatigue check; none met all three warning conditions.
insights.action: Keep monitoring frequency, link CTR and CPL together. Review individual ads when all three deteriorate; low-volume groups remain inconclusive.
insights.basis: 2026-07-18–2026-07-24 vs 2026-07-25–2026-07-31. Screening rule requires frequency +20%, link CTR −15% and CPL +20%, with 5 leads, 30 link clicks and 1,000 impressions in each window. No flag does not prove the absence of fatigue.

insights.title: Cost per lead 6.0% lower than last month
insights.observation: August: $2,168.06, 85 leads and $25.51 CPL. Prior month: $2,169.78, 80 leads and $27.12 CPL. Largest lead gain: Chattanooga, TN (+14 leads, +6.05 USD spend change). Largest lead decline: Remarketing - Opened Form no Submit (-9 leads, +5.32 USD spend change).
insights.action: Review the largest declining ad set first and compare its offer, audience and ads with the prior month. Change one factor at a time.
insights.basis: Complete calendar months; Meta lead action only. Different month lengths and lead quality can affect interpretation.

insights.title: Lead efficiency to investigate: Chattanooga, TN
insights.observation: $900.60 generated 45 leads at $20.01 CPL. This is 52.9% of leads on 41.5% of spend; the account CPL is $25.51.
insights.action: Review this ad set’s audience, offer and relevant storage capacity before a small budget test. Check lead quality separately; past CPL does not establish how extra spend will perform.
insights.basis: Lowest CPL among ad sets with at least 10 reported leads; descriptive, not a controlled experiment.

insights.title: Review higher-cost enquiries: Remarketing - Opened Form no Submit
insights.observation: $311.15 generated 8 leads at $38.89 CPL, 52.5% above the account average.
insights.action: Inspect the audience, offer and individual ads. Use a controlled change and monitor the next comparable period rather than assuming the audience should be paused.
insights.basis: Comparison mixes different audiences and locations; it does not measure lead quality.

insights.title: Lead volume is concentrated in one ad
insights.observation: 02 (Chattanooga, TN) generated 39 leads at $19.96 CPL — 45.9% of account leads.
insights.action: Keep a tested alternative creative available and monitor this ad weekly. Unequal delivery means this is not proof that its creative is intrinsically better.
insights.basis: Lead-share calculation uses ad-level results reconciled to the account; no causal creative ranking.

insights.title: Creative fatigue is not established
insights.observation: 1 ad set(s) had enough activity for the seven-day fatigue check; none met all three warning conditions.
insights.action: Keep monitoring frequency, link CTR and CPL together. Review individual ads when all three deteriorate; low-volume groups remain inconclusive.
insights.basis: 2026-08-18–2026-08-24 vs 2026-08-25–2026-08-31. Screening rule requires frequency +20%, link CTR −15% and CPL +20%, with 5 leads, 30 link clicks and 1,000 impressions in each window. No flag does not prove the absence of fatigue.

insights.title: Lead efficiency to investigate: Chattanooga, TN
insights.observation: $273.06 generated 11 leads at $24.82 CPL. This is 64.7% of leads on 43.5% of spend; the account CPL is $36.96.
insights.action: Review this ad set’s audience, offer and relevant storage capacity before a small budget test. Check lead quality separately; past CPL does not establish how extra spend will perform.
insights.basis: Lowest CPL among ad sets with at least 10 reported leads; descriptive, not a controlled experiment.

insights.title: Creative fatigue is not established
insights.observation: 1 ad set(s) had enough activity for the seven-day fatigue check; none met all three warning conditions.
insights.action: Keep monitoring frequency, link CTR and CPL together. Review individual ads when all three deteriorate; low-volume groups remain inconclusive.
insights.basis: 2026-08-27–2026-09-02 vs 2026-09-03–2026-09-09. Screening rule requires frequency +20%, link CTR −15% and CPL +20%, with 5 leads, 30 link clicks and 1,000 impressions in each window. No flag does not prove the absence of fatigue.
